context: A police officer briefs about a case
purpose: Teach: 人的/地上波/成り立ち/林業/沼/沿線/練っ/質感

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 今回の事件、人的被害は最小限でした。
lines.en: Fortunately, this incident resulted in minimal loss of life.
lines.style: Even, measured delivery. Professional composure. No affect on the difficult words—just stating fact. Slight pause before the ending, as if acknowledging weight without dwelling on it.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 地上波で広く報じられましたよね。
lines.en: It did get quite a lot of coverage in the news, didn't it?
lines.style: Genuine curiosity, not challenge. Lean forward slightly. Moderate pace, looking to Officer Takeda for confirmation. The tone of someone asking to understand, not to test.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: はい。事件の成り立ち、初動で見抜けました。
lines.en: Yes. We were able to piece together what happened from the initial response.
lines.style: Slight nod on 'yes.' Professional clarity. Each clause delivered with quiet conviction. Tempo steady. The cadence of someone who has rehearsed this account but means every word.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 山間部の林業地帯、捜索、難航したそうですね。
lines.en: The search in those mountain forest areas was quite difficult, I understand?
lines.style: Thoughtful, careful question. Slightly slower pace to show respect for the difficulty. Genuine—not fishing for drama. Eyebrows slightly raised, inviting him to elaborate.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: はい。捜索中、沼に近づいた箇所、危険でした。
lines.en: Yes. There were several spots near marshland that presented serious danger to the search teams.
lines.style: Clinical but not cold. Precise word choice. A brief pause after 'Yes,' then steady delivery. The tone of someone prioritizing accuracy over reassurance.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 容疑者、沿線駅で防犯カメラに映っていましたね。
lines.en: The suspect was captured on security footage at a station along the rail line, correct?
lines.style: Careful, respectful phrasing. Moderate pace. Not pressing—offering him a chance to confirm. The intonation of someone who has done the homework and is checking the facts.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: はい。捜査計画、慎重に練った上で、動きます。
lines.en: Yes. We developed the investigative strategy carefully before moving forward.
lines.style: Slight emphasis on 'carefully'—not rushed. Tempo steady, grounded. The confidence of procedure done right. No defensiveness, just quiet assurance.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 凶器の質感、専門家、分析中ですか。
lines.en: Are the forensic specialists still analyzing the weapon?
lines.style: Close, focused question. Quieter tone than before—narrowing in. Respect for the specialized work. Patient, as if aware that this takes time.
